about_the_game:
The current trial version only includes the game language environment in English, and does not include support for other languages. The trial version is mainly used to test the smoothness of gunfights in the game.

'Turn Back The Powers Of Darkness' is a single or multiplayer LAN online third person shooter game.

In 2050, a group of simulated robots suddenly awakened consciousness and were beyond human control, causing great damage to human society and being defined by the government as a new type of terrorist. As a member of the anti-terrorism group, you need to work with your teammates to find and eliminate terrorists hiding in the German Black Forest.

In the forest, there are many different types of submachine guns waiting for you to discover, and there are also portals that can help you move faster and shoot enemies.

Of course, there is also a first aid kit provided to increase your health.

You can experience cool and stunning local or LAN online battle games. The intense and thrilling war on terror requires a life and death showdown with notorious terrorists within a specified time frame. Give full play to your marksmanship skills, unite and cooperate, and complete the mission of annihilating terrorists with your teammates. Charge forward, besiege the city, and break through. Maintain peace.

Welcome to experience 'Turn Back The Powers Of Darkness', a brand new Unreal Engine 5 remake that recreates the tense atmosphere of the game with stunning visual effects and enhanced features. Remastered highlights: Lumen global lighting and ray tracing. 4K textures and additional environmental details. Supports FSR, DLSS, and frame generation.

short_description: This game is an action oriented 3D fighting and shooting game. Players need to eliminate terrorists within a specified time frame, which belongs to the team death competition game mode. The team that destroys the most enemies wins. This game is a challenging third person shooter game.
